note: The narration decides what the character feels and does with the letter.
narration: The paper is thin, folded in thirds, the ink bled at one corner as though it had been carried through rain. It begins with your name. You feel a rush of guilt and decide to burn it in the stove before anyone can read it, holding it over the flame until the corner curls black.

characterContext.playerSummary: A ferry-hand with a borrowed name.
